text: dsh-liquid-glass 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的外观插件，在设置通用页提供液态玻璃开关、透明度滑块和自定义壁纸控件。它通过主题 token 覆盖让页面及多类界面表面呈现半透明效果，并支持亮暗配色；用户可上传图片或填写图片 URL，预览、保存或移除背景。透明度和壁纸保存在当前浏览器，适合希望个性化 DSH 界面并让背景透出的用户。

dsh-liquid-glass adds a glass toggle, opacity slider, and custom wallpaper controls to DSH Web settings. Theme token overrides make interface surfaces translucent in light and dark schemes. Users can upload or link a background, preview it, and change it. Preferences stay in the browser.
想让 DSH 网页界面变成半透明的玻璃效果
能不能给 DSH 的页面换一张自己的背景图？

怎么在 DSH 设置里上传并预览壁纸？
Make the DSH web interface translucent so a wallpaper shows through.
I want to set a custom background image for my DSH page.
Can I adjust the glass opacity from the settings screen?
Let me upload, preview, replace, or remove my DSH wallpaper.
dsh-liquid-glass 的功能「全界面玻璃效果」：启用后覆盖多种页面表面主题 token，并按亮色或暗色方案设置半透明颜色。设置通用页的开关可启用或关闭效果。
dsh-liquid-glass 的功能「透明度调节」：设置通用页的滑块调整玻璃透明度，变化会立即应用并保存在浏览器。
dsh-liquid-glass 的功能「自定义壁纸」：在设置中上传图片或输入图片 URL，预览并保存为全页背景，也可替换或移除。上传图片会压缩后保存。
dsh-liquid-glass 的功能「外观偏好保存」：玻璃开关、透明度和壁纸写入浏览器 localStorage，客户端加载时读取并恢复设置。
dsh-liquid-glass 使用前须知：玻璃开关、透明度和壁纸都保存在当前浏览器的 localStorage；浏览器存储不可用或空间不足时，读写会被忽略。

**Liquid glass for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)** — one toggle, and the whole interface turns to glass.

dsh-liquid-glass README · dsh-liquid-glass：Translucency built for DeepSeek Harness: the page base, cards, panels and chat bubbles all go see-through over your own background image, with a single slider for exactly how much glass you want. Nothing else — the best tools are the simple ones.

dsh-liquid-glass README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-liquid-glass
```

Open **Settings → General** — a **Liquid Glass** row appears. It is ON by default; restart once after install.

dsh-liquid-glass README · What you get：- **Full-shell transparency**: every surface the shell paints — page base, cards, panels, sidebar, chat bubbles, code blocks — goes translucent through the official ThemeRuntime token-override layer. Neutral white on the light scheme, near-black on dark.
- **One master transparency slider** (3%–95%): higher values reveal more of the background.
- **Full-page custom background**: upload a local image (auto-compressed for localStorage) or paste a URL. It spans the whole page behind the glass.

dsh-liquid-glass README · Privacy and compatibility：- Settings and uploaded backgrounds stay in this browser's `localStorage`; the plugin has no server component and sends no telemetry.
- The UI integrates through DeepSeek Harness's public client runtime, locale, slot and theme APIs.
- Light and dark color schemes are supported. A DSH restart is required once after installation so the client bundle can be loaded.

dsh-liquid-glass README · Verify from source：The smoke test runs the published client bundle inside a mocked DSH browser runtime and exercises registration, lifecycle, settings, persistence, wallpaper controls and slider bounds:

```sh
node test/smoke.test.mjs
```

dsh-liquid-glass README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-liquid-glass
```

Preferences live in this browser's localStorage and are left behind harmlessly.
